introHtml: When outfitting a military unit or base, standard cutlery won't cut it. Custom military knives, blocks, and sets are built with rugged materials like stainless steel and acacia wood, designed to withstand heavy use in mess halls or field kitchens. Options like the Leatherman Skeletool KBX or Hampton Forge Epicure sets can be engraved with unit insignia or service branch logos, making them ideal for morale gifts, retirement ceremonies, or base supply. Bulk ordering ensures consistent branding across all pieces.
